blind.description: A swaddled mummified body or corpse bundle lying horizontally on the ground. It features layered light tan linen wrappings secured by criss-crossing darker tan cloth straps, with a distinct reddish-brown neck strap separating the small head bundle from the torso and legs. The surface is continuous, solid, and cleanly textured without floating parts, holes, or melting. It rests directly on the floor without an added plinth or base.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as an elongated, tapered bundle lying vertically: a smaller rounded head at the bottom with a dark red collar, widening into shoulders/torso, and gently tapering toward the feet at the top, crossed by diagonal bandage straps.
blind.height_vs_figure: Lying flat on the ground, its length is roughly two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 3.5 to 4 feet long), about 1.2 feet wide, and under 1 foot tall.
